derivation.cache_hits: frontend-query cases with baseline hits require at least the baseline hit count
derivation.lsp_query_cache: not enforced until LSP exports stable per-request cache counters
derivation.lsp_query_median_ms: smoke fixed broad; otherwise min(slo_median, max(baseline_median * 3, baseline_median + 5ms))
derivation.lsp_query_p95_ms: smoke fixed broad; otherwise min(slo_p95, max(baseline_p95 * 4, baseline_p95 + 10ms))
